text:
alex: I created candidate RC: v1.14.0-rc2 from main at 1789012345. Artifact built and available. Planning promo during the 2h change window starting in ~90m. Can QA/SRE +1?

deploybot: Artifact: redwood-inference/service:v1.14.0-rc2
sha256: 3f2a9b7d...
Bake status: 12m
Canary recipe: 10% -> 50% over 20m -> 100% over 40m
Command to promote: `deploybot promote --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.0-rc2 --env prod --pin rc-1.14.0-2`

marta: quick sanity: smoke tests passed in staging, e2e flaky on a single test (quota-exhaustion) but blue-green looks fine.

raj-qa: QA: ran regression suite against rc2. Found a minor tokenization diff in chat-streaming (low impact, documented in release notes). Marking QA as conditional +1, will re-run the failing e2e after infra patch.

sam: SRE: infra team flagged a noisy NVMe spike on the cluster used for canaries earlier today. We're rolling a minor kernel fix scheduled in 40m. Prefer we hold final promo until after that fix and re-check latency P95.

alex: OK — thanks. My proposal: pin this artifact to a reserved promo slot (so it doesn't get GCed) and hold the promo until SRE confirms the fix. If fix lands and P95 looks good in 10m bake, we trigger the canary. Thoughts?

jordan: +1 for pin. Also suggest adding KV-warm step before canary traffic shift. Small script: `curl -X POST https://warm-api.internal/prefill -d '{"keys":5000}'`

lucy-sre: I'll own the rollout watch. Plan: deploy kernel fix at T+40m, validate NVMe IOPS and tail-latency threshold (<150ms p95) for 10m. If green, we remove hold and let deploybot run the canary. If any regression, rollback kernel and abort promo.

alex: pin command executed: `deploybot pin --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.0-rc2 --tag rc-1.14.0-2` :thumbsup:

deploybot: Pin acknowledged. Pinned artifact rc-1.14.0-2 -> retention 72h.

marta: noted. I'll re-run the flaky e2e after SRE signal. If it still fails, we'll either patch in a hotfix or abort promo.

raj-qa: adding release note entry: "chat-streaming: minor tokenization diff observed under edge-case bursts; fallback unchanged." Will attach repro steps.

lucy-sre: Kernel patch rolled out to canary infra at T+40m. Monitoring: NVMe IOPS stable, tail-latency p95 dropped from 210ms -> 95ms within 5m.

sam: saw the same. Telemetry looks good, no error spikes. Recommend proceeding to KV warm + canary.

alex: ok pulling the trigger in ~2m on the KV-warm then canary. @deploybot please run the pre-canary steps and start canary once warm-up is complete.

deploybot: Running pre-canary steps:
1) KV-warm script -> 5000 keys
2) prefix cache restore for model embeddings
3) create canary slice (10%) and route health checks
Starting canary in 1m.

marta: watching e2e rerun now.

raj-qa: e2e now PASS on the previously flaky test. QA -> +1 final.

deploybot: Canary started: traffic=10% -> metrics baseline compare live.

alex: Monitoring window 20m. lucy and sam, please shout if anything odd.

lucy-sre: 20m in, no regressions. p95 stable, no new errors.

sam: telemetry delta: tokenization errors unchanged, latency within expected delta. Proceeding to 50% ramp.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% -> OK.

alex: After 50% bake + 20m, if green we promote to 100% and close the RC. Anyone object?

marta: no objections.

raj-qa: fine by QA.

lucy-sre: I'll keep the watch until 100% and hold an abort if anything crosses threshold.

deploybot: Final promotion command queued: `deploybot promote --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.0-rc2 --env prod --pin rc-1.14.0-2 --finalize`

alex: Promotion complete. Release notes draft: 1) v1.14.0: improved streaming, minor tokenization note. 2) pinned artifact rc-1.14.0-2 for rollback.

marta: creating the changelog PR and tagging release in repo.

lucy-sre: closing watch. No incidents. Great job.

alex: thanks all. Marking thread as resolved. :tada:
